input: Izuba lyakabbila munsi lya julu, lyakapa mumuni uupya mumigwagwa yamunzi iizwide bantu. Bantu bakafwambaana kweenda munzila, maulu aabo akali kulila munzila aawo mibandi niyakali kuvwundauka. Mumaanda aakulida, kununkilila kwa kofi yakabikwa mpya kwakali kuswaangana akununkilila kwazyakulya zyakabikwa, akutamba basikwiinda kuti baime mpawo bakkomane. Basikuzyana mumigwagwa bakayungizya nyimbo zyakwiimba, akusandula munzi kuba chikozyano chibotu chamajwi amibala. Mangolezya naakasika, malambe aamudolopo akali kumweka-mweka, akumunikila kuzyana kwabuumi bwamunzi butakali kwiima pe.

Kuzabuka busena bupati bwamalundu aamalundu mabotu, guwo lyakavwiya maseseke kwiinda mumafwaafwi. Banyama bamusyokwe bakali kuzuzaana munsi lyachiluli, kweenda kwabo kwakali mbuli bbola lyakali kuchitwa munsi lyaliso lyamulengalenga. Mulonga wakazungaana asyoonto-syoonto mukati kanyika, atala lyawo wakali kutondezya mumuni wazuba mpawo wakali kupanga zintu zimwekamweka zyakali kukkomanisya meso. Bayuni bakali kwiimba nyimbo zyakali kulibonya mbuli kuti zyakali kwaamba makani aanyika, lwiimbo lwabuumi lwakali kulimvwisya mukuumuna. Muchiimo eechi chaluumuno, chiindi chakali kulibonya kuti chakali kucheya, akuzumizya ziindi zyakuyeeya aluumuno kuti zizwidilile.

Mukati ka laibbulali mpati, mashelufu akali kutandabala loko, kazwide mabbuku aamakani woonse. Kununkilila kwamapepa aachembaala azyakuvwunga zyachikumba kwakazula muya, kutamba basikuvwuntauzya luzibo kuti bavwuntauzye munyika zitabaliki. Basikubala bakakkala mumasena mabotu amatebulu mapati, meso aabo kalanga mapeeji aawo mizeezo yabo niyakali kweendeenda mumizeezo, twaano, azintu nzyobakajana. Chimwi chiindi, muzuzumo wakuvwungulula mapeeji wakali kuvwungulula muzuzumo wakubikkila maanu. Aanze, nyika yakazumanana kuzuza, asi mukati kamalambo aaya, nyika yoonse yabusongo akweezyeezya yakakomena mukuumuna.

Kubusena bwakusambalila bwakazwide bantu, basambazi bakakoongolola nzyobakali kuula, kabayanda kuti bantu bababikkile maanu akataa majwi manji. Zisambalilo zyakazwide micelo mibotu, tununkilizyo tununkilizyo, azyakusama zyamibala, chimwi achimwi chakaamba makani aakuzwa akuchitwa. Basikuula bakabandika aatala amiulo mpawo bakabandika twaano, mpawo bakapanga chikozyano chibotu chakujatana kwabantu. Kununkilila kwanyama yakangwa azyakulya zibotu zyakali kuvwuuma mumuwo, zyakali kusunka basikwiinda kuti balye. Akati ka manyongwe, kwakali nzila yakali kuchitika - kuzungaana kwakapa kuti muulo kaupona akupona, chitondezyo chamuuya wakuyanzana.

Mulwizi lupati, mayuwe akauma chikumba chabwato, akutuma maanzi aamunyo mujulu. Basikubeleka bakaunka kabajisi makanze, kababambulula maseila akweenda mubusena bupati bwamubala wa bbuluu, kabasololelwa buyo anyenyeezi alimwi akuzyiba zintu. Mulengalenga wakatandabala cakutaleka, cisani camibala iicinca-cinca kuzwa mafwumofwumo kusikila kumangolezya, kutondezya bubotu bwanyika butaambiki. Inziba zyakali kuzinguluka atala, kulila kwazyo kwakali kulila mumaanzi, akuyungizya kulila kwalwizi. Nikuba kuti lwizi lwakali lulikke, kulimvwa kweendeenda akujana zintu zyakazwidilila akati kazyintu zitaambiki.

Mukati ka busena bwakusobelela bwamunzi buzwide bantu, kuseka kwabana kwakali kumvwika aawo nibakali kusobana amasena aakuseluka. Mikwasyi yakalya picnic aamabbulangeti aakamwaikide mubwizu, kabaambilana twaano akukkomana kuba antoomwe munsi lyamisamu milamfwu. Basikuzuza abasikutanta njinga bakali kweenda munzila zizungaana, kweenda kwabo kwakali kupa kuti kube luumuno lwazilengwa leza mukati kabuumi bwamunzi. Madada ama swans zyakali kuseluka kabotu-kabotu atalaa zyiba, akuyungizya luumuno. Buzuba nibwakamana, busena bwakusaanina bwakasanduka kuba busena bwakulyookezyela ooko bantu bakkala mudolopo nkobakajana kulyookezya kuzwa kuzintu nzyobakali kuchita lyoonse.

Mutwe wacilundu wakapa kubona kubotu kwamilonga iizingulukide alimwi amitwe yazilundu zili kule. Basikutanta bakali kuzyunguluka mulilo muniini, kabaabila twaano twalweendo lwabo aziloto zyakumbele. Muya wakali mubotu alimwi wakali kuyumya-yumya, wakali kuzuzya mapunga amuuya uusalala, uukatalusya. Zibeela zyachivwulamabwe zyakali kujatilila kumalundu aamabwe, zyakali kumweka-mweka munsi lyamumuni wazuba, zyakali kwiimpana anyika iisiyidwe azisyango zisyoonto munsi. Makumbi naakali kwiinda, mitunta yakali kusobana mubusena, kutondezya bubotu bwabusena oobo. Kwiimvwi atalaa nyika, umwi wakalimvwa kujatana kupati abupati butamani bwazilengwa leza.

Mubusena butakwe muzuzumo, mikwasyi yakali kuchita zintu zyabo zyabuzuba abuzuba kakunyina kuzungaana. Bana bakali kusana hopscotch mumbali aanzila, kuseka kwabo kwakali kulila mujulu aawo bazyali nibakali kulangilila kabalangilila kuzwa kumabbuwa aali afwaafwi. Miunda yakazwide mibala myiingi - ma rose, ma tulips, ma daisy - oonse kaali kuzundana mumuni wazuba akubikkilwa maanu. Kununkilila kwabwizu bupya bwakatemwa amaluba aakali kumena kwakapa kuti kube muya uukkomanisya walo wakavwumbilila bube bwaŋanda. Mangolezya kwakaleta mumuni uuteteete wamalaiti aamumigwagwa akumvwa kuzumanana kwaluumuno oolo kanjikanji lutabonwi pesi luyandisi kapati.

Matongo aakaindi akali kwaamba twaano twabantu bakamana, maanda aabo aamabwe akamana pesi akazumanana. Misaansa amusyokwe zyakali kweenda mumigodi, kutondezya kweenda kwachiindi akubweedezya zilenge zyabantu. Basikuvwuntauzya bakali kweendeenda mumaanda aajisi ziluli, kabayeeya buumi bwakali kupona mukati kamaanda aaya. Kuumuna kwakali kupati, kwakanjililwa biyo akulila kwamikondo akulila kwakayuni. Izuba nilyakali kubbila musule lyamabwe, mitunta yakakomena, yakabikka muuya wamaseseke akulemeka kubusena oobo. Chakali chiyeekezyo chakubako kwachiindi chilamfu alimwi amakani aakabikkidwe mubbwe lyoonse.

Mubbuwa lyandeke lyakazwide bantu, basilweendo bakainda chakufwambaana kabalangilila akulombozya. Mavwili aakunyamuna zintu akali kuvwuuma aansi aasalala aawo mibandi mumyaambo myiingi niyakali kuzula mujulu. Zipekupeku zya dijitali zyakatondezya chiindi chakuzwa akusika, kusololela basikweenzya batakwe moyo mulamfu naakuti bakkomene kuya nkobaya. Inkomeki zyakofi azintu zyakuvwungaila zyakulya zyakazwide mumakkona amwi, bumboni bwakufwambaana kulya chakulya chakuseni akulibambila kwamamanino. Akati kantenda zyakabambilwa, kwakaba kumvwisisisya antoomwe - chiindi chifwiifwi chakuswaangana akataa beenzu bakaangidwe akuyandisya kuvwuntauzya, kupiluka, naa kuyandaula matalikilo mapya. Lweendo lwakali afwaafwi kuzumanana.

Kunsumbu mbotu, mayuwe mabotu akali kuzungaana kunkomwe zyamusenga, akutamba kulyookezya akuyeeya. Misamu yamisamu yakali kuzungaana muchiimo chakubula nguzu mumuwo walwizi, mifanikisyo yayo yakali kwiimpana amulengalenga uusalala pyu. Basikuunka kunkomwe yalwizi bakali kuyoya zuba, bakayaka maanda aamusenga, akuyobolola zikwabilizyo zyamulwizi, kabachita zintu ziuba-uba zyakali kutondezya paradaiso. Munsi lyamaanzi, ma coral reefs aasalala akalizwide zintu zyamulwizi zyamibala, zyakali kubonwa kwiinda mumaanzi aasalala aatondezya nyika iisisidwe yazigambyo. Mangolezya naakali kuyaabuswena, mulengalenga wakaba amubala wa orenji a pinki, kutondezya mamanino aabuzuba bumbi mubusena oobu butakwe muzuzumo. Bubotu bwansumbu eeyi bwakapa busena bwakuyubila kule kuzwa kulila kwabuumi bwabuzuba abuzuba.

Muchiyaka chamaofesi chamazubaano, babelesi bakali kubelekela antoomwe mumaanda aakuswaanganina aamagilazi amumasena aakubelekela aajulikide. Kuvwuuma kwamakkompyuta akulila kwamafooni kwakapa kuti kube muzuzumo uutamani, wakali kuchitwa akulila kwamakkiibhodi akusanganya mapepa. Zipinda zyakulyookezyela zyakapa chiindi chakulyookezya, ababelesinyina kabanywa kofi akubandika. Mabboodi aatuba alimwi azipekupeku zyakali kutondezya maccaati, chiindi chapulojekiti, amizeezo yakali kuchincha, zyoonse zyakali kubeleka kuzuzikizya mbaakani zyomwe. Nikuba kuti kwakali milimo minji, kwakali kulimvwa kuba amakanze akuchita zintu zipya zyakapa kuti kube kuyaambele akuzwidilila kwamazubaano.

Chitishini chachitima chizwide bantu chakabeleka mbuli busena bwakuswaanganya kweendeenda, ooko twaano tutabaliki ntwaakaswaangana. Basikutanta bakafwambaana kunjila muzitima zyabo, kabajisi zibbeeke amabbeeke, umwi aumwi kajisi nkobaya aziloto. Basambazi bakauzya zyakulya zifwaafwi amapepa aamakani antoomwe amakkawunta amatikiti aamvwika amajwi akwaambilizya. Busena bwakazungaana akaambo kakulangila aawo injini nizyakali kulila, kutondezya kuzwa akusika. Muchibaka eechi chifwiifwi, ziindi zyakuswaangana akwaandaana zyakaswaangana, kazyeendelezya buumi bwabuzuba abuzuba munyika iitaleki kweenda.

Mukati kapati kamusyokwe, mumuni wazuba wakasefa kwiinda mumafwaafwi aamafwaafwi, mpawo wakabikka mabala aasalala anyika iiteteete munsi. Zilenge zyamisyobo yoonse zyakali kweenda kakunyina kuzungaana mubusena bwazyo, chimwi achimwi kachita mulimu wacho mumulongo wabuumi. Muya wakalivwubide akununkilila kwamusokwe, musamu wa pine, abulongo buteteete, zyakali kupa kuti muntu alimvwe mbuli kuti wakali kukkalikana kaindi. Mulonga mutete wakali kwiinda muzisamu, kuvwuuma kwawo kwakali kubeleka mbuli lwiimbo lwakukkazika moyo kunkanda iitakwe muzuzumo. Busena oobu butakwe bantu bwakazumanana kuba bumboni bwakuyuma kwazilengwa leza abubotu butamani bwabusena butakwe bantu.

Ikkichini yakazwide milimu aawo basikujika nibakali kujika zyakulya zyiingi. Kulila kwakutontola kuzwa mumapani kwakasanganizigwa akununkilila kwamasamu, tununkilizyo, acinkwa chipya, kupa kuti kube busena bubotu. Zintu zyakali kubelesyegwa zyakali kugonkwa, kuvwundaulwa, akusanzyigwa kabotu-kabotu, cimwi acimwi cakali kugwasya kuti zintu zifwefwemale zyeendelane. Babelesi bakali kweenda kakunyina kukatazyigwa aakati kaziteshi, kababelekela antoomwe kuchitila kuti bbazu lyomwe lyomwe lisike kabotu. Beenzu bakali kulindila chakulya chabo, kulangila kwakali kuyaa kukomena aawo zintu zyakujika nizyakali kuswaangana antoomwe — chakulya chimwi achimwi chakali chintu chabusongo chakabambilwa kukkomanisya mizeezo akukkutya moyo.

Mubusena bwakutondezya zintu zyakuzekaula, maanda akali aazifwanikiso zyaandeene, zibezedwe, azifwoto. Beenzu bakali kweenda asyoonto-asyoonto kuzwa kuchibeela kuya kuli chimwi, umwi awumwi wakali kwiima kuti asandulule akulumba zilengaano zyabasikuzekaula. Mumuni wakatondezya bupange azintu zimwi, akupa kuti zintu zyakuzekaula zibe abuumi. Mibandi iitakwe muzuzumo aatala anzila, kulimvwa, ancozyaamba zyakayungizya bupati kuzintu zyakachitika. Busena oobo bwakali busena bwakuyubila bwakulenga akuyeeya, ooko nguzu zyakutondezya zintu zyakasungwaazya mizeezo mipya akusungwaazya kuyeeya.

Muchiindi chamafwumofwumo kuchiziba, kkumbi lyakazwa atala aamaanzi, mpawo lyakapa kuti kube muya mubotu. Madada akali kutanta bwato bwakubula nguzu, akusiya mayuwe mumbali lyawo, mpawo tuyuni twakali kuzuzaana atala aatete. Kuumuna kwa mafwumofwumo kwakatyolwa buyo akulila kwabayuni bakali kutambula buzuba. Zisamu zyakali kuzingulukide zyakali kulibonya mumaanzi aakkazyika moyo, akuyungizya luumuno. Eechi chiindi chaluumuno chakatondezya bubotu bwazilenge nyika kaitanabuka, kutuyeezya luumuno luli mubukkale bwazilenge.

Malaiti aabusena bwakuchitila zisobano akamana aawo kketeni niyakatanta, mpawo kwakayubununa busena bwakuchitila zisobano zitalubiki. Basikusobana bakanjila mumilimo yabo, kabatondezya bantu kabajisi luyandisisyo alusyomo, akupa kuti makani abe abuumi. Baswiilizi bakabotelwa, kuseka akuuma maanza kwakali kuchitika muziindi zikatazya loko. Nyimbo amumuni zyakasumpula kulimvwa abukkale, akusandula busena kuba busena bwakuyeeyela akugambwa. Aawo chisobano nichakamana, bantu bakavwuuma maanza, kabasekelela busongo akusoleka kwakapa kuti chisobano eechi chibe chintu chitalubiki kuliboonse.

Mumasena aatakwe muzuzumo, maanda akaliimvwi mumilongo mibotu, aimwi kajisi muunda wayo uuzwide maluba azisamu. Migwagwa yakazwide bantu bazyibidwe akuzuminana, kutondezya kulimvwa kwakuyanzana akukkazika moyo. Bana bakali kusana mumaanda aawo bapati nibakali kuchita milimu yaaŋanda naakuti kababandika aamabbuwa. Kuvwuuma kwabuumi bwabuzuba abuzuba kwakapa kuti kube busena bubotu, kutondezya mbociyandika kuba aŋanda akuswaangana. Mangolezya naakasika, kumweka kuteteete kwamalaiti aamulyango kwakatambula masiku, akukkalila mubukkale bwaluumuno bwamudolopo.

Mugwagwa wamulundu wakali kuzungaana kuya mujulu kwiinda mumasena aajisi mabwe, akukatazya basikweenda kabajisi zilundu zilamfwu alimwi amabwe. Ntaamu imwi aimwi yakali kuyandika kubeleka changuzu akukakatila, mpawo yakapegwa bulumbu bwakulanga zintu zibotu loko atala aacilundu. Muya uutontola wamalundu wakayumya mizeezo, mpawo maluba aamusyokwe azisyango ziyumu zyakali kujatilila kumilyango yamabwe. Chimwi chiindi, kulila kwa nziba kulaale naa kubona mpongo yamulundu kwakali kuyeezya basikweendeenda bubotu bwamusyokwe bwakabazingulukide. Kusika achilundu chakaba chiindi chakuzunda, chitondezyo chakukakatila anguzu zigambya zyazilenge.

Busena bwakusambalila mudolopo lyansiku bwakali busena bwakuchitila zintu zyiingi, abasambazi bakali koompolola zintu zyabo mpawo basikuula bakali kusambala kabakkomene. Zisambalilo zyakazwide zintu zyakabambwa amaanza, tununkilizyo, azyakusama, chimwi achimwi chakali kwiiminina chibeela chazilengwa zyamunzi. Kununkilila kwazyakulya zitaambiki kwakazula muya, akusunka basikwiinda kuti basole zyakulya zipya. Kulila kwanyimbo akuzyana kuzwa kuli basikwiimba bakali afwaafwi kwakayungizya muya uukkomanisya. Busena oobu buzwide bantu bwakali kwiinda buyo busena bwakusambalila; wakali muswaangano wamakani aakaindi, zilengwa, akujatana kwabantu.

Munsi lyajulu lyamasiku, mulilo wakali kuyaka mpawo wakabikka mitunta iizyana kumeso aabasilweendo bakakatede. Kabaambilana twaano akwiimba nyimbo, bakakkomana alukkomano lwabulongwe. Mulilo wakali kupya wakali kupa kupya mumuwo uutontola, mpawo nyenyeezi zyakali atala zyakali kupa chikozyano chakujulu chakugambya kutamani. Kulila kwachipopwe kulaale akuvwuuma kwamafwaafwi kwakapa kuti kube kukkazyika moyo. Muchiindi eechi, kazingulukidwe azilenge abeenzuma, chiindi chakali kulibonya kuti chiliimvwi nji, kakukankaizya bubotu butamani bwakuzwa anze.

Muswaangano wabasikwiiya wakabunganya antoomwe basyaabusongo bazwa munyika yoonse kuti baabile mizeezo akubandika zintu zipya. Basikukanana bapati bakapa makani aakulwaizya, akutalisya nzila zipya zyakubuzya akubelekela antoomwe. Zibeela zyakuzwangana zyakasungwaazya mibandi yabantu boonse, akukulwaizya mbungano yabantu bayanda kuziba. Kucincanya luzibo kwakagwasyilizyigwa azintu zyakuyanzana azintu zyachiyanza, izyakasumpula luzibo kunze lyalwiiyo. Muswaangano nowakamana, aabo bakatola lubazu bakatola kunembo mizeezo mipya anzila zyakubelekela antoomwe, zyakapa kuti kube kuyaambele mumbazu zyabo.

Mvwula nsyoonto yakawida mudolopo, yakapa kuti kube kupompa kwamawindo aaziluli. Basikweenda amawulu bakafwambaana munsi lyamaambulela, ntaamu zyabo zyakali kufwambaana pesi tiizyakali kufwambaana pe, mbuli mimuni mboyakali kumweka-mweka aamugwagwa uuteteete. Kununkilila kwanyika iiteteete amvwula mpya kwakapa kuti muntu alimvwe kabotu, akupa kuti muntu alimvwe kabotu mubuumi bwamunzi. Mimuni yamumugwagwa ilamweka mbuli ngolide, ikwiindana amulengalenga uutontola, ikuyungizya kupya kubusena oobo. Kulyookezya akukkazika moyo kwakanjila mubusena bwakuvwundauka kwakusaanguna, aawo munzi nowakatambula mvwula, akuyeezya boonse nguzu zyazilengwa leza.

Tempele lyansiku lyakaliimvwi mbuli bumboni bwabusongo bwabantu abukombi, maanda aayo aamabwe akanyonganizyigwa amuwo amuwo kwamyaanda yamyaka. Zifwanikiso zibezedwe kabotu-kabotu azikozyanyo zyakali kubamba kunembo lyayo, kazivwundauka twaano twakulipeda alimwi atwaano. Beenzu abaswaya boonse bakajana luumbulizyo akusololelwa mumasena aayo aatakwe luumuno, oomo kuumuna akulemeka kwakazula muya. Kubako kwatempele kwakaswaanganya chiindi chakainda achiindi chino, mpawo kwakali chiyeezyo chisetekene chazilengwa leza akuyandaula bupanduluzi butamani. Aawo mumuni wazuba nowakali kwiinda mumampangala amumampangala, kulimvwa kuti taakwe chiindi kwakavwumbilila busena oobo.

Pobwe lyakusekelela lyakali lyamibala, muzuzumo, akusekelela. Zyakutanta zyakali kuzungaana akutanta, kazizwide koompolola kwakukondwa, mpawo masena aakusobanina akali kupa zyoolwe zyakujana bulumbu akuseka. Basikusobana kabasamide zizwaato bakabotezya makamu aabantu azisobano zyakusobana, masalamusi, azisobano zyakwiimba, zyakajata mizeezo yabantu bamyaaka yoonse. Kununkilila kwa maswiiti aa cotton, mapopwe, ama soseji aakangwa kwakapa kuti basikwiiya bachite oobo. Nikwakasika masiku, malambe aamweka-mweka anyiimbo zyakapa kuti kube muya uujisi nguzu zyakusekelela lukkomano, kuswaangana, azintu ziuba-uba zyakulikondelezya mubuumi.

Mukkona lya layibrari litakwe muzuzumo, tebulu lyomwe lyakali kumunikwa a lampi, lyakali kutamba sikubala kuti asweekelwe mubbuku. Mapeeji akajisi nyika zyakusobana, luzibo, akulimvwa, umwi aumwi wakali mulyango wakumvwisisisya kupya naakuti kutija. Kuumuna kwakapa kuti kube kubikkila maanu akuyeeya, busena bwakuyubila kuzwa kuntenda zyaanze. Afwiifwi, mashelufu aabambidwe kweendelana amutwe wamakani amulembi akapa mizeezo mibotu yabantu akulenga. Ooku kuyubila kwakuyanda kuziba kwakatondeezya nguzu zitamani zyakubala zyakusungwaazya, kuyiisya, akusandula.

Muunda wamasaansa wakali atala aamalundu, misaansa yawo yakazwide misaansa iibide iilibambilide kutebulwa. Babelesi bakali kweenda munzila iili kabotu aakati kamilongo, kabatebula akutebula, umwi awumwi wakali kulanganya nyika oobotu aluzibo. Izuba lyakabikka mubala wangolida atala aabusena bubotu, mpawo lyakatondezya mibala iiteteete alimwi amabala aasalala pyu. Muya wakazwide tununkilizyo tubotu twamicelo abulongo, kutondezya buumi bwakulima. Aawo chiindi chakutebula nichakali kuyaabuswena, kulangila kwakakomena kwakuti waini wakali kuyanda kuchitwa kuzwa kuzibunga eezyi ziyandisi.

Idolopo lyakavwumbidwe aachivwulamabwe lyakali busena bubotu bwakubonena muchiindi chamupeyo, aamaanda aakali kuvwumbidwe mubala uutuba alimwi amabwe aacivwulamabwe aakali kulengaana atala aaziluli. Migwagwa yakaliimvwi, yakavwumbidwe akuwa kwachivwulamabwe, mpawo kwakapa kuti kube luumuno. Bana bakayaka bantu bachivwulamabwe mpawo bakali kulwana bbola lyachivwulamabwe, kuseka kwabo kwakali kulila mujulu. Mimuni iipya kuzwa mumaanda aamaanda aakusambalila yakasiyana kabotu abusena butontola, mpawo yakapa kuti kube kusekelela. Busena boonse bwakali kulibonya mbuli kuti bwakali kumweka-mweka akaambo kamasalamuzi aamwaka, akutamba boonse kuti bakkomane luumuno lwachiindi chamupeyo.

Mudolopo lyakazwide bantu, mato aakunyamuna zintu amaato aakuzuba nswi akali kuzungaana muchibbeeke, zikobela zyawo zyakali kusika mujulu. Babelesi mubwato bakafwambaana kweenda, kababikka akugwisya zintu zyakali kugwasya buvubi bwamunzi akubuswaanganya anyika yoonse. Zisambalilo zyakali kumbali aalwizi zyakali kupa nswi zipya, zintu zyakabambwa amaanza, azintu zyakuyeeya kuli basilweendo abantu bamumo. Kununkilila kwamaanzi aamunyo, nswi, a dizili zyakasangana mumuwo, kutondezya buumi bwamulwizi. Aawo mato naakali kweenda naa kusika, munzi wakali kuzwidilila mukweenda, makwebo, akukwela kwalwizi.

Busongo bwakujika bwakazuzya ŋanda yakujika zinkwa amununko mubotu, uukkomanisya walo wakakulwaizya basikwiinda kuti banjile mukati. Chinkwa chakajika azyakulya zyakali kubikwa kabotu-kabotu mumabbokesi aakutondezya, zikumba zyazyo zyangolida antoomwe azibeela ziteteete zyakali kusunka mizeezo. Basikupanga zinkwa bakali kulila aawo nibakali kuuma fulaulu akupanga zinkwa, luzibo lwabo lwakali kulibonya muzintu zyoonse. Basikuula bakabotelwa abusena bubotu, kabanywa kkofi naa tii, kababandika azyakulya zyakajika. Ooku kujika tiikwakasanina luzutu pesi kwakaswaanganya bantu kwiinda muzilengwa, busongo, alukkomano lwachakulya chibotu.

Akati kamulimo uuzwide bantu, basimilimo bakabeleka changuzu mumilimo yabo, chibeela chimwi achimwi chitondezya luzibo aluyandisisyo. Zintu zyakali kuzwa kuzisamu abutale kusikila kuchisani abulongo, abasyaazibwene bakali kusandula zintu zitabelesyegwi kuba zintu zibeleka. Mizuzumo yamasaha, nkomo, azibelesyo zyakuluka zyakaswaangana mukwiimba kwakulenga. Beenzu bakabotelwa amilimo yamaanza, kanjikanji bakali kukulwaizyigwa kuti bachite milimu yabo yabusongo. Muswaangano ooyu wakali bumboni bwabusongo bwamuntu akubotezya zintu zyakabambwa amaanza, zijisi mpindu.

Muchiindi chepobwe lyakali kukkomanisya, zintu zyakali kweenda amaluba amalaiti zyakali kweenda mumigwagwa, kusekelela zilengwa leza amuuya wakuyanzana. Basikusobana kabasamide zizwaato bakazyana akulizya nyimbo, kabakkomanisya basikweebela bamyaaka yoonse. Maanda aakulida akali kupa zyakulya zibotu zyachiindi, kabaabila zintu zibotu kuzwa kumazyalani aakainda. Muya wakazwide kusekelela, kuseka, akubotelwa antoomwe kwakutola lubazu. Nikwakasika masiku, mulilo wakamweka mujulu, kutondezya mamanino aachintu chibotu, chitalubiki chakapa kuti bantu kabasekelela antoomwe.

Busena butakwe muzuzumo bwakali myuunda amasyokwe, ooko chiindi nkochakali kulibonya kuti chiyaabumana. Balimi bakali kulanganya zilyo azivwubwa, zyintu nzyobakali kuchita zyakazwa muzilengwa zyamyaka minji. Tumunzi tusyoonto twakali akati kazisamu ziteteete, antoomwe amaanda aakali kulibonya kabotu. Mivwi mibotu yazilengwa leza — bayuni kabaimba, guwo kalivwuuma mumafwaafwi, kulila kwang'ombe iili kule — kwakapa kuti kube lwiimbo lubotu. Busena oobu bubotu bwakali kupa busena bwakulyookezyela kuzwa kubuumi bwamudolopo, akuyeezya beenzu luumuno akuubauba kujanika mukutambula zilenge.

Muchibbadela chamazubaano, basyaazibwene mumulimo wabusilisi bakabeleka changuzu kulanganya balwazi, kulipeda kwabo kwakali kulibonya mulizyoonse nzyobakali kuchita. Busena butakwe bulwazi bwakali busena bwakuchitila milimu, manesi abasilisi bakali kweendelezya busilisi akulangisisya zitondezyo zyabuumi. Inzila zyakupanga zintu zisumpukide zyakagwasya kuzyiba bulwazi akuponya, kutondezya kuswaangana kwaluzyalo akupanga zintu zipya. Balwazi bakajana luumbulizyo mubusongo abubotu bwababelesi, kabasyoma makanze aabo aakubukulusya buumi bubotu. Busena oobu bwakali bumboni bwakukakatila kwabantu akuzumanana kuyandaula kuponya.

Nkanda yakatandabala cakutaleka, busena bupati bwamusenga amalundu aamabwe munsi lyazuba lipya. Ma cacti azisyango ziyumu zyakakakatila kubuumi mubusena oobu butali kabotu, kusima kwazyo kwakali kugambya. Beenzu bakali kweenda mubusena oobo kabacenjede, kabazyi ntenda abubotu buli munkanda eeyi. Zifwanikiso zyakali kumweka kulaale, zintu zyakuyeeyela zyakali kusobana ameso pele zyakali kuyungizya maseseke aabusena oobo. Kubbila kwazuba kwakasandula nkanda kuba chisani chamibala iisalala pyu ama orenji, chikozyano chifwiifwi changuzu zyazilengwa leza abubotu bupati.

Kaanda kabotu kakali akati kamisamu milamfwu kakapa busena bwakuyubila kuzwa kunyika yakunze. Maanda aamulilo akali kulila, akupa mumuni uupya walo wakali kugwasya busena bwakulisakatizya. Beenzu bakali kukkala amabbuku naakuti kwaabila twaano, kabakkomana aluumuno lwabusena bwabo. Aanze, chivwulamabwe chakawida ansi, chakavwumbilila busena amubala uutuba, mpawo mukati, kwakali kupya akukkazika moyo. Busena oobu bwakuyanzana bwakabikkilizya kujokela mubuumi buuba-uba akuumbulizyigwa kujanika mukukumbata kwazilengwa leza, busena bubotu bwakutija bwakulyookezya akubukulusya.

Muchibaka chakuchitila zisobano chamudolopo, basizisobano bakalibambila kusule lyachibuwa, kuyoowa kwabo akubotelwa kwabo kwakali kulibonya. Nkamu yanyimbo yakabamba zibelesyo zyabo aawo kuvwuuma maanza akuvwundauka kwakazula mubusena bwakuswaanganina. Chiindi chisitilizyo nichakatanta, busena bwakasanduka kuba nyika yamaseseke, masesya, naa mapenzi, akubotezya baswiilizi akupa kuti bantu kabalimvwa kabotu. Kukamantana kwakutondezya — basizisobano, baimbi, basikubeleka aachibuwa — kwakapa kuti kube mulimo mubotu wakaindi kaniini wakaliko buyo muchiindi eecho. Aawo chisobano chamamanino nichakamana akuvwuuma maanza kwakazwa, masalamuzi aazisobano akayeezya boonse nguzu zyakwaamba twaano akulitondezya kwabuntu.

Lubuwa lwaba Monastery lwaluumuno lwakali busena bwakuyeeya akukkazika moyo. Bama monk bakali kweendeenda cakupozya mumaanda aabapaizi, kabalanganya myuunda akulibambila mipailo yabuzuba abuzuba. Kununkilila kwatununkilizyo amaluba aakali kumena kwakayungizya buumi bwakumuuya, akukulwaizya kuyeeya akukkazika moyo. Beenzu naakuti bantu bakali kukkala mumo bakajana luumbulizyo mubuuba-uba akulilemeka kwabuumi bwaba Mozilemu, ooko kuyeeya akuyanzana nkokwakali kuswaangana. Kazwide muzilengwa zyakaindi, busena oobu busetekene bwakali kupa busena bwakuyubila bwamoyo akati kantenda zyaanze.

Aabusena bwakuyakila buzwide, babelesi bakabelekela antoomwe kuyaka busena bupya, umwi awumwi wakapa luzibo lwakwe. Kulila kwabutale akuvwuuma kwaminchina kwakatondeezya kuyaambele, mpawo milawu yakukwabilila yakapa kuti boonse kabakwabilidwe. Zintu zyakasika munzila iitazungaani — konkriti, zibulo zyabutale, zitina — chibeela chimwi achimwi chakali kuyandikana mukusyomeka kwapulojekiti. Basikuzekaula abainjiniya bakali kulanganya mulimu, akusinizya kuti nzila yakubamba yakazuzikizigwa. Busena oobu bwakali bumboni bwakuyanda kwabantu akubeleka antoomwe kwakayandika kuti makanze azuzikizigwe.

Ibbwe lya coral lyakazwide buumi munsi lyamaanzi aalwizi aasalala. Nkamu zyanswi zyamibala-bala zyakali kuzuzaana akati kamitabi yamakorali, kakuli nziba zyamulwizi zibotu zyakali kuzuzaana kwiinda. Busena bwazilenge bwamulwizi bwakali kugwasya misyobo myiingi, umwi awumwi wakali kuchita mulimu mupati mukubamba kweendelana. Basikusotokela mumaanzi abasikusotokela mumaanzi bakalanga-langa paradaiso eeyi iili ansi aamaanzi, kabagambwa abubotu bwayo akusiyana kwayo. Kukwabilila busena oobu butakwe nguzu kwakali kuyandikana loko mukukwabilila buumi bwamulwizi mumazyalani aaboola.

Mutempele lyachi Buddhist, bapaizi bakachita zilengwa akuzinzibala kuyeeya, akupa kuti kube luumuno akubikkila maanu kuzintu zyabukombi. Kununkilila kwatununkilizyo kwakali kuvwuuma mumuwo aawo lwiimbo lwakali kumvwika asyoonto-syoonto, kusololela basikuchita mukati. Zikozyanyo azifwanikiso zyabaleza zyakapa busena bwakukomba akuzinzibala kuyeeya, akupa kuti kube kumvwana akulemeka. Beenzu bakali kuyandaula luumuno akumvwisisisya bakajana luumbulizyo mukukkazika moyo kwatempele. Masena aasetekene aaliboobu akali kubeleka mbuli busena bwakuvwuntauzya mukati akukomezya luzyalo.

Busena bwakulyookezyela bwakusekelela bwakalizwide zintu zyiingi aawo basikweenda aamabwe aachivwulamabwe nibakali kweenda mumasena aajisi chivwulamabwe amumigwagwa yamalundu. Zibbula zyakunyamuna zyakali kunyamuna beenzu kuya kumalundu, kupa kubona busena buzwide maanzi aachivwulamabwe. Nikwakainda buzuba bwakuswaya, beenzu bakabungana mumaanda mabotu, kabaambilana twaano akulipya amulilo uuyaka. Kununkilila kwa chokoleti iipya azyakulya zibotu zyakazula muya, akupa kuti kube kusekelela kwakatobela. Busena oobu bwakusobelela bwamupeyo bwakali bwakusekelela luyando, zilengwa leza, akuyanzana, akupa kuti kube kuyeeya kwakatola chiindi chilamfu nikwakamana maanzi aatontola.

Mukati ka laboratory iisumpukide, basayaansi bakachita zyintu zyakusunka, kabasyoma mubusongo aluzibo. Zibelesyo zyakali kumweka-mweka munsi lyamumuni uumweka-mweka aawo nibakali kulanga-langa zitondezyo akulemba data, kabayandaula luzibo lwanyika yazilengwa leza naakuti kuyaambele kwabusongo. Kubelekela antoomwe akuyandisya kuziba zyakasololela mulimu wabo, kanjikanji zyakapa kuti kube kuzwidilila kwakali kukonzya kugwasya bantu. Busena bwakali kusanganya kweendelezyegwa kabotu akuvwuntauzya kutakwe mpindu, kutondezya muuya wamuntu wakujana zintu zipya. Kuzwa kuli koonse kwakagwasizya mukuyandaula kumvwisisisya akuyaambele.

Sitolo yamabbuku iili kabotu mu Mugwagwa Mupati yakakkomanisya bantu bayandisya mabbuku akaambo kakuboneka kabotu alimwi amashelufu aazwide mabbuku. Basikubala bakalanga-langa mabbuku aakabungikwa kabotu-kabotu, akujana balembi bapya alimwi abasikulemba bakaindi. Kununkilila kwamapepa aakaindi kwakavwumbilila beenzu, akuyungizya lukkomano lwakujana twaano aluzibo. Babelesi bali kabotu bakapa lulayo, akuyungizya kujatana kwamuntu mwini. Ooku kuyubila kwamabbuku kwakakulwaizya kuswaangana, kweezyeezya, akwiiya, akukomezya kujatana aakati kamabala abaabo baayandisya.

Mumuunda mupati wamisamu, misamu mibotu kuzwa munyika yoonse yakatondezyegwa muzibeela zyakabambilwa oobotu. Nzila zyakali kuzungaana kwiinda mumaluba mabotu, madambwa aatakwe muzuzumo, amumasena aajisi mumvwula, zyakali kutamba kuvwuntauzya akukkazika moyo. Basikulima bakali kulanganya musamu umwi aumwi caluyando, kabasinizya kuti misyobo yazisyango zitavwuli kujanika alimwi abubotu bwabusena bwakakwabililwa. Beenzu bakagambwa akusiyana kwamisamu, kwiiya aatala akujatana kwazyintu zipona anzila zyakulima. Muunda wakabeleka mbuli busena bwakuyubila kulibaabo bazyi kabotu abaabo bapya, mbuli chikozyano chipona chakugambya kwazilengwa leza abusongo bwabantu.

Busena bwakulikondelezya bwakapa zintu zikkomanisya akutontola ama roller coasters, mavwili aa Ferris, azisobano. Mimuni iimweka-mweka alimwi anyimbo zibotu zyakapa kuti kube muya uukkomanisya walo wakakwela makamu aabantu kuzwa afwaafwi akulamfwu. Bana abapati boonse bakajana ziindi zyakubotelwa akusekelela, kabayeeya zintu zyakachitika mukati kakusekelela akubula mulimo. Zisambalilo zyakapa zyoonse kuzwa ku cotton candy kusikila kuzyakulya zibotu, zyakapa kuti kube kweendeenda kuzumanana. Ooku kuseka kwakulikondelezya akuseka kwakasekelela kuubauba akubotelwa kwakulyookezya kakunyina kulibilika, kuyeezya boonse lukkomano lujanika mukwaabana zintu.

Muŋanda yabeenzu yakumuunzi, beenzu bakakkomana akulyookezya kuzwa kumapenzi aabuumi bwabuzuba abuzuba. Zibelesyo zyamumuunzi amumuni uupya zyakapa kuti kube busena bubotu, mpawo chakulya chibotu chakapa kuumbulizyigwa akupona. Busena bwakazingulukide bwakajisi myuunda iizunguluka azisamu zitakwe muzuzumo, zyakali kabotu kweendeenda akuyeeya. Kusamausya kwamukamwini ŋanda yabeenzu kwakapa kuti kube kulimvwa kwakuliiba akulyookezya, kupa kuti beenzu balimvwe mbuli kuti bali aŋanda. Ooku kuyubila kwakuubauba azilengwa leza kwakapa kulyookezya kubotu, akuswaanganya basilweendo abuumi bwakumyuunzi butazungaani, buli kabotu.

I museum mubotu, wamazubaano wakatondezya zintu zyiingi zyakuzekaula, makani aakaindi, azintu zyasayensi. Beenzu bakayinka kwiinda muzitondezyo zyakabambilwa oobotu, kababelesya zintu zigwasya antoomwe amapepa aakuyiisya. Bupange bwamayake bwakali bwabusongo, bwakabikkilizya anzila mpya zyakupanga zintu kuti zigwasye azintu zyakali kutondezyegwa mukati. Mapulogilamu aakuyiisya azintu zyaalubazu zyakapa kuti kube luyandisisyo lwakuyanda kuzyiba akwiiya. Ng'anda yakuyobweda zintu zyakaindi yakabeleka mbuli bbulogwe liswaanganya zyakachitika chiindi, zyamazubaano, azyakumbele, akusungwaazya beenzu kuti balumbaizye busongo bwabantu abusongo bwabo boonse.

Atala aacilundu chitakwe muzuzumo, ŋanda yakukombela nsyoonto yakali kulanga busena buzingulukide, ŋanda yayo yakali kusika mujulu. Beenzu abaswaya bakali kuboola kuzoojana luumbulizyo, kupaila, naakuti kukkomana biyo azintu zibotu. Malambo aamabwe azintu zilimukati zitakatazyi zyakatondezya kulibombya akulemeka, zyakapa kuti kube ziindi zyakuzinzibala kuyeeya akuswaangana. Busena bwakali chiyeekezyo chakuyandisya kwabantu kwakukomena akumvwisisisya. Kubbila kwazuba, ŋanda yabukombi yakaboneka mbuli mumuni wabulangilizi aluumuno akati kabunji bwazilenge.
